title: Jonah and the Kitchen
author: Casper Delacroix
blurb: Paloma Coldharbour, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
